'''December 2001 Huntsville tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held in The Deep, Huntsville in December 2001. It is known from Efridge Engelhardt's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d3199">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-12-19-huntsville-chase-the-cand3199/ huntsville-chase-the-can], DeckTech (Efridge "Efridge" Engelhardt, 19 December 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-12-19-huntsville-chase-the-cand3199/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' December 2001
* '''Site:''' The Deep, Huntsville
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Reflections III]]
